=================================================================== */ /* ── TOKENS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ const C = { bg: "#06050F", bg1: "#0A0917", bg2: "#0F0D1E", card: "#131128", card2: "#181630", bdr: "rgba(255,255,255,.07)", bdra: "rgba(220,160,40,.22)", gold: "#D4A017", goldL: "#F0BA35", amber: "#E8A020", ambl: "#FFB83A", grn: "#22C55E", txt: "#F2EDE6", muted: "#7A7190", dim: "#352F4A", red: "#EF4444", grad: "linear-gradient(135deg,#D4A017,#F0BA35,#E07010)", gradS: "linear-gradient(135deg,#D4A017,#E8A020)", }; /* ── STORE GLOBAL — persistance complète ─────────────────────────── */ /* Toutes les données du restaurateur stockées dans localStorage et partagées entre Dashboard et Site public via Context React */ const StoreCtx = createContext(null); const STORE_KEY = "tr_store_v6"; const IMGS_KEY = "tr_imgs_v6"; // stockage séparé pour les images (base64) function loadStore() { try { const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY) || sessionStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY); if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) {} return null; } function saveStore(data) { try { const s = JSON.stringify(data); localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, s); // Backup dans sessionStorage pour plus de résilience sessionStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, s); } catch(e) {} } function loadImgs() { try { const raw = localStorage.getItem(IMGS_KEY) || sessionStorage.getItem(IMGS_KEY); if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) {} return {}; } function saveImgs(imgs) { try { const s = JSON.stringify(imgs); localStorage.setItem(IMGS_KEY, s); sessionStorage.setItem(IMGS_KEY, s); } catch(e) {} } /* Convertit un File en base64 pour persistance */ function fileToBase64(file) { return new Promise((res, rej) => { const r = new FileReader(); r.onload = e => res(e.target.result); r.onerror = rej; r.readAsDataURL(file); }); } function StoreProvider({ children }) { const savedStore = loadStore(); const savedImgs = loadImgs(); const DEFAULT_INFO = { name: "Mon Restaurant", addr: "", phone: "", whatsapp: "", email: "", open: "11:00", close: "22:00", wave: "", orange: "", }; const [info, setInfoRaw] = useState(savedStore?.info || DEFAULT_INFO); const [dishes, setDishesRaw] = useState(savedStore?.dishes || []); const [planJour, setPlanJourRaw] = useState(savedStore?.planJour || {}); const [orders, setOrdersRaw] = useState(savedStore?.orders || []); const [imgs, setImgsRaw] = useState(savedImgs || {}); const logoSrc = imgs.logo || null; const coverSrc = imgs.cover || IMGS.hero; /* ── Stats calculées à partir des vraies commandes ─────────── */ const stats = React.useMemo(() => { const completed = orders.filter(o => o.status !== "Annulé"); const revenue = completed.reduce((s, o) => s + (o.total || 0), 0); const clients = new Set(completed.map(o => o.phone || o.clientPhone || o.id)).size; return { total: orders.length, revenue, clients, rating: 0, /* sera implémenté quand les avis seront ajoutés */ }; }, [orders]); const persistAll = (nextInfo, nextDishes, nextPlanJour, nextOrders) => { saveStore({ info: nextInfo, dishes: nextDishes, planJour: nextPlanJour, orders: nextOrders }); }; const setInfo = (upd) => { setInfoRaw(prev => { const next = typeof upd === "function" ? upd(prev) : { ...prev, ...upd }; saveStore({ info: next, dishes, planJour, orders }); return next; });
